title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 43
paragraphs: Then Antichares, a man of Eleon, gave him counsel out of the oracles of Laius, to make a settlement at Heraclea in Sicily, saying that the whole land of Eryx belonged to the Heraclidae, since Heracles himself had won it. On hearing this, Dorieus went at once to Delphi to ask the oracle whether he would be able to conquer the land he was setting out for; and the Pythian priestess replied that he would conquer it. Dorieus therefore took with him the force he had led before to Libya, and sailed along the coast of Italy.
